title: Yvelvety Sour Cacao Panna Cotta
description: A velvety Irish dish featuring cacao that is perfect for a weeknight dinner and suitable for Buddhist temple-friendly settings.
instructions: Combine milk and heavy cream in a saucepan.
Add vanilla extract, cacao paste, and powdered sugar to the saucepan.
Stir until everything is fully incorporated. Bring mixture to a simmer on medium heat.
Reduce heat to low and add agar agar slowly while stirring continuously until it dissolves completely.
Continue cooking for about 5 minutes or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon (mushimoto-steaming).
Let cool slightly before serving, garnishing with additional vanilla extract if desired.
